create-table-with-header-and-data-rows.title: Create and Populate a Table in a PDF
create-table-with-header-and-data-rows.description: Shows how to add a new page, create a Table, populate it with header and data rows, and save the modified PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-table-into-pdf.title: Insert Table into PDF at a Specific Position
insert-table-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to open an existing PDF, create a visual Table with borders and padding, position it using margins, and insert it onto a specified page at given coordinates.

auto-fit-table-columns-to-content.title: AutoFit Table Columns to Content in PDF
auto-fit-table-columns-to-content.description: Loads an existing PDF, creates a table with header and data rows, applies ColumnAdjustment.AutoFitToContent to size columns based on cell contents, inserts the table into the first page, and saves the result.

stretch-table-to-page-width.title: Stretch Table to Full Page Width in PDF
stretch-table-to-page-width.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF document, adding a table whose columns are defined as percentages so the table automatically fits the page width, and saving the result.

insert-svg-image-into-table-cell.title: Insert SVG Image into PDF Table Cell
insert-svg-image-into-table-cell.description: Demonstrates creating a table in a PDF, adding a text cell and an SVG image cell, and saving the document using Aspose.Pdf.

embed-html-in-table-cell.title: Embed HTML in Table Cell using HtmlFragment
embed-html-in-table-cell.description: Shows how to add an HtmlFragment containing HTML markup to a table cell's paragraph collection in a PDF document created with Aspose.Pdf.

insert-page-break-after-table-row.title: Insert Page Break After a Specific Table Row
insert-page-break-after-table-row.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF with a table and force a page break after a chosen row using Aspose.Pdf's TextFragment.

render-table-on-new-pdf-page.title: Render Table on a New PDF Page
render-table-on-new-pdf-page.description: Creates a PDF document, adds a blank page, builds a table with header and data rows, and places the table on the page.

merge-table-cells-colspan.title: Merge Table Columns Using Cell.ColSpan in PDF
merge-table-cells-colspan.description: Demonstrates how to merge three adjacent columns into a single cell in an Aspose.Pdf table by setting the Cell.ColSpan property and applying a background color.

merge-table-cells-vertically-rowspan.title: Merge Table Cells Using RowSpan in PDF
merge-table-cells-vertically-rowspan.description: Shows how to create a tagged PDF table with Aspose.Pdf and merge a cell with the one below by setting the RowSpan property.

set-custom-cell-margins-in-pdf-table.title: Configure Table Cell Margins in PDF
set-custom-cell-margins-in-pdf-table.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF with a table and setting cell padding using a MarginInfo object assigned to the table's DefaultCellPadding property.

set-default-cell-padding-for-pdf-table.title: Set Default Cell Padding for Table in PDF
set-default-cell-padding-for-pdf-table.description: Creates a PDF document, adds a table, and applies uniform cell padding to all cells by setting Table.DefaultCellPadding with a MarginInfo instance.

get-rendered-table-width-after-layout.title: Calculate Rendered Table Width After Layout
get-rendered-table-width-after-layout.description: Loads a PDF, creates a table with explicit column widths, forces layout by saving to a memory stream, and computes the actual rendered width of the table by summing its column widths.

import-datatable-into-pdf-table.title: Import DataTable into PDF Table
import-datatable-into-pdf-table.description: Demonstrates creating an in‑memory DataTable, importing its rows and column headers into an Aspose.Pdf Table, and saving the result as a PDF document.

import-filtered-dataview-into-pdf-table.title: Import Filtered DataView into PDF Table
import-filtered-dataview-into-pdf-table.description: Shows how to create a DataView with a filter, set column widths, and import the view into an Aspose.Pdf Table using Table.ImportDataView, then save the result as a PDF.

create-pdf-table-from-datatable.title: Create PDF Table from DataTable
create-pdf-table-from-datatable.description: Shows how to populate a DataTable, import it into an Aspose.Pdf Table, and save the result as a PDF document.

check-table-break-across-pages.title: Determine If a PDF Table Is Broken Across Pages
check-table-break-across-pages.description: Loads a PDF, verifies it contains tagged content, finds the first table element in the structure tree, and reads its IsBroken property to see if the table spans multiple pages.

mark-table-header-enable-column-repeat.title: Create Table with Repeating Column Header in PDF
mark-table-header-enable-column-repeat.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf's TaggedContent API to build a table, mark the first column cells as header (TH) elements so the column repeats on each new page, and save the updated PDF.

extract-tables-from-pdf.title: Extract Tables from PDF Using TableAbsorber
extract-tables-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF document, apply TableAbsorber on each page to detect tables, and iterate through the extracted tables to read their location and row/column details.

replace-table-in-pdf.title: Replace Table in PDF Document
replace-table-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to locate the first table on each PDF page, remove it, and insert a newly created table at the same position using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-first-table-from-pdf.title: Remove First Table from PDF using TableAbsorber
remove-first-table-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to locate tables in a PDF with TableAbsorber and delete the first found table, then save the modified document.

remove-all-tables-from-pdf.title: Remove All Tables from a PDF Document
remove-all-tables-from-pdf.description: Shows how to locate every table in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber and delete them before saving the document.

batch-add-table-with-logo-to-pdfs.title: Batch Add Table with Company Logo to PDFs
batch-add-table-with-logo-to-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through a folder of PDF files, insert a two‑column table containing a company logo and name on the first page of each document, and save the modified files to an output folder.

apply-different-autofit-behaviors-to-tab.title: Apply Different AutoFitBehavior Settings to Tables in a PDF
apply-different-autofit-behaviors-to-tab.description: The example loads an existing PDF, creates two tables with different ColumnAdjustment settings (AutoFitToWindow and AutoFitToContent), and adds them to the same page to demonstrate varied table sizing.

set-cell-background-color-in-pdf-table.title: Set Cell Background Color in PDF Table
set-cell-background-color-in-pdf-table.description: Shows how to apply a background color to specific cells of a table in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-solid-border-to-pdf-table.title: Apply Solid Border to PDF Table
add-solid-border-to-pdf-table.description: Shows how to create a table in a PDF document and set a solid black border around the entire table using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-image-into-table-cell.title: Insert External Image into PDF Table Cell
insert-image-into-table-cell.description: Shows how to load an external image file and embed it into a table cell of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-image-into-pdf-table-cell.title: Insert Image from Memory Stream into PDF Table Cell
insert-image-into-pdf-table-cell.description: Shows how to load an image into a MemoryStream and embed it into a table cell of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-text-fragment-to-table-cell.title: Add Text with Font and Size to Table Cell
add-text-fragment-to-table-cell.description: Demonstrates how to insert a TextFragment into a table cell and set its font and size using Aspose.Pdf. The example creates a PDF, adds a table, and customizes the text appearance.

add-centered-paragraph-to-table-cell.title: Add Centered Paragraph to Table Cell in PDF
add-centered-paragraph-to-table-cell.description: Demonstrates how to create a table in a PDF, add a cell, and place a centered paragraph (TextFragment) inside that cell using Aspose.Pdf.

set-cell-vertical-alignment-middle.title: Set Cell Vertical and Horizontal Alignment in PDF Table
set-cell-vertical-alignment-middle.description: Shows how to create a PDF document with a table and align each cell's content vertically to the middle and horizontally to the center using Aspose.Pdf.

center-table-horizontally.title: Center Table Horizontally in PDF
center-table-horizontally.description: Shows how to create a PDF document with a table and align the table to the center of the page using Aspose.Pdf.

offset-table-left-margin.title: Offset Table from Left Margin in PDF
offset-table-left-margin.description: Demonstrates how to create a table, set its left margin offset, add rows, and insert it into a PDF page using Aspose.PDF for .NET.

split-table-across-pdf-pages.title: Enable Table Splitting Across PDF Pages
split-table-across-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to allow a table to break across multiple PDF pages by setting Table.IsBroken to true and adding enough rows to span pages.

prevent-table-splitting.title: Prevent Table Splitting Across PDF Pages
prevent-table-splitting.description: Shows how to disable automatic table breaking by setting Table.IsBroken to false, forcing the entire table to stay on a single PDF page.

calculate-remaining-page-space-add-table.title: Calculate Remaining Page Space and Add Table to PDF
calculate-remaining-page-space-add-table.description: Loads a PDF, computes the vertical space left on a page after accounting for margins and existing text, then creates and inserts a table that fits within the remaining space.

create-fixed-width-table-pdf.title: Create Fixed-Width Table in PDF
create-fixed-width-table-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF with a table whose width is fixed to 500 points using Aspose.Pdf.

set-table-width-percentage.title: Set Table Width to 80% of Page Width
set-table-width-percentage.description: Demonstrates creating a table in a PDF and defining its total width as 80% of the page by using percentage column widths.

map-datatable-columns-to-pdf-table.title: Map DataTable Columns to PDF Table Using Aspose.Pdf
map-datatable-columns-to-pdf-table.description: Shows how to map DataTable column names to specific columns of an Aspose.Pdf Table via a dictionary, populate the table, and save the PDF.

create-pdf-table-from-filtered-dataview.title: Filter DataView Rows and Import into DataTable
create-pdf-table-from-filtered-dataview.description: Shows how to apply a RowFilter on a DataView to select active records and import only those rows into a destination DataTable.

populate-pdf-table-from-linq-data.title: Populate PDF Table from LINQ Query via DataTable
populate-pdf-table-from-linq-data.description: Demonstrates converting a LINQ query result to a DataTable, importing it into an Aspose.Pdf Table, and saving the table in a PDF document.

add-table-to-specific-pdf-page.title: Add Table to Specific PDF Page
add-table-to-specific-pdf-page.description: Shows how to insert a table into a chosen page of a PDF by accessing Document.Pages and adding the Table to the page's Paragraphs collection using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-table-after-paragraph.title: Insert Table After Paragraph in Tagged PDF
insert-table-after-paragraph.description: Demonstrates how to locate a paragraph in a tagged PDF, create a table with header and body elements, and add the table to the document's logical structure.

insert-table-before-first-image.title: Insert Table Before First Image in PDF
insert-table-before-first-image.description: Shows how to locate the first image on each PDF page and insert a simple two‑column table before it using Aspose.Pdf.

create-repeating-table-header.title: Create Repeating Table Header in PDF
create-repeating-table-header.description: Shows how to add a table to a PDF with a header row that repeats on each new page using Aspose.Pdf's tagged content API.

style-table-header-row-pdf.title: Apply Styling to PDF Table Header Row
style-table-header-row-pdf.description: Demonstrates creating a table in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and setting a background color and bold font for the header row cells.

add-table-footer-to-pdf.title: Add Footer Row to Tagged PDF Table with Automatic Page Repetition
add-table-footer-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a table in a tagged PDF, add a footer row, and rely on Aspose.Pdf to repeat the footer on each page when the table spans multiple pages.

create-pdf-table-alternating-row-colors.title: Apply Alternating Row Background Colors to PDF Table
create-pdf-table-alternating-row-colors.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate the first table, and set alternating background colors for each row's cells using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-hyperlink-into-table-cell.title: Add Hyperlink to PDF Table Cell
insert-hyperlink-into-table-cell.description: The example opens a PDF, creates a tagged table with a paragraph in a cell, and adds a LinkAnnotation that links the cell text to an external URL, then saves the document.

add-checkbox-form-field-in-table-cell.title: Add Checkbox Form Field to a Table Cell
add-checkbox-form-field-in-table-cell.description: Demonstrates creating a tagged table in a PDF and inserting a CheckboxField form field into a specific table cell using Aspose.Pdf.

add-radio-button-group-in-table-cell.title: Add Radio Button Group Inside a Table Cell
add-radio-button-group-in-table-cell.description: Shows how to place a group of radio button fields within a PDF table cell using Aspose.Pdf by creating RadioButtonOptionField objects that share the same PartialName.

export-pdf-table-structure-to-json.title: Export Table Structure from Tagged PDF to JSON
export-pdf-table-structure-to-json.description: Extracts tables from a tagged PDF by traversing the logical structure tree, collects cell text and alternative text, and serializes the data to a JSON file.

export-pdf-table-to-csv.title: Export PDF Tables to CSV
export-pdf-table-to-csv.description: Shows how to extract tables from a tagged PDF using Aspose.Pdf and write each row as a comma‑separated line in a CSV file.

serialize-pdf-table-to-xml.title: Serialize PDF Table to XML
serialize-pdf-table-to-xml.description: Shows how to extract tagged tables from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and convert the rows and cells into an XML document.

render-xml-table-to-pdf.title: Create PDF Table from XML Definition
render-xml-table-to-pdf.description: Loads a table definition from an XML file, constructs an Aspose.Pdf.Table with rows and cells, and saves the result as a PDF document.

count-tables-in-pdf.title: Count Tables in PDF using TableAbsorber
count-tables-in-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, apply TableAbsorber to detect tables, and retrieve the number of tables via the TableList collection.

extract-table-coordinates-from-pdf.title: Extract Table Coordinates from PDF using TableAbsorber
extract-table-coordinates-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, use Aspose.Pdf.TableAbsorber to detect tables on each page, and retrieve the bounding rectangle coordinates of each table.

extract-text-from-pdf-tables.title: Extract Text from PDF Tables using TableAbsorber
extract-text-from-pdf-tables.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, use TableAbsorber to detect tables, and iterate through rows and cells to read each cell's text fragments.

replace-text-in-pdf-table-cells.title: Replace Table Cell Text by Keyword in PDF
replace-text-in-pdf-table-cells.description: Demonstrates how to locate a table cell containing a specific keyword in a PDF and replace its content with a new TextFragment using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-column-from-pdf-table.title: Remove Table Column from PDF
remove-column-from-pdf-table.description: Shows how to delete a specific column from all tables in a PDF by removing the corresponding cell elements from each row using Aspose.Pdf's tagged content API.

insert-new-column-into-pdf-table.title: Insert New Column into PDF Table
insert-new-column-into-pdf-table.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, locate a table, and insert a new column by adding a Cell to each Row at a specified index, then save the updated document.

reorder-pdf-table-columns.title: Reorder Table Columns in a PDF
reorder-pdf-table-columns.description: Shows how to extract cell texts from a tagged PDF table, create a new table with a custom column order, and save the modified document.

adjust-table-column-widths-proportionall.title: Adjust Table Column Widths Proportionally in PDF
adjust-table-column-widths-proportionall.description: The example loads a PDF, creates a tagged table, converts absolute column widths to percentage values based on the total width, builds header and data rows, and saves the modified document.

set-minimum-column-width.title: Set Minimum Column Width for Tagged PDF Table
set-minimum-column-width.description: Demonstrates how to create a tagged PDF table with Aspose.Pdf and enforce a minimum column width by setting the TableElement.ColumnWidths property, including building the table header, body, and cells.

set-maximum-table-column-width.title: Set Maximum Column Widths in a PDF Table
set-maximum-table-column-width.description: Demonstrates how to create a table in a PDF and limit each column's width to a specified point measurement using Aspose.Pdf.

add-auto-numbered-column-to-pdf-table.title: Add Auto‑Numbered Column to PDF Table
add-auto-numbered-column-to-pdf-table.description: Shows how to create a tagged PDF table with Aspose.Pdf and fill the first column with sequential numbers for each row.

add-table-with-semi-transparent-backgrou.title: Add Semi-Transparent Background to Tagged PDF Table
add-table-with-semi-transparent-backgrou.description: Demonstrates how to create a tagged PDF table with Aspose.Pdf, set a semi‑transparent background color, and populate header and data rows.

set-table-z-index.title: Set Table Z-Index in PDF
set-table-z-index.description: Demonstrates loading an existing PDF, creating a table, setting its ZIndex to control overlapping order, adding it to a page, and saving the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-table-into-paragraph-collection.title: Insert Table After a Paragraph in PDF
insert-table-into-paragraph-collection.description: Demonstrates how to add a paragraph of text to a PDF page and then insert a formatted table immediately after it using Aspose.Pdf for .NET.

import-images-from-datatable-into-pdf-ta.title: Import Images from DataTable into PDF Table
import-images-from-datatable-into-pdf-ta.description: Demonstrates loading image byte arrays from a DataTable and inserting each image into a PDF table cell using Aspose.Pdf.

render-table-high-dpi-images.title: Render Table with High‑DPI Images in PDF
render-table-high-dpi-images.description: Creates a PDF containing a 2×2 table where each cell holds a high‑resolution image, preserving image quality using Aspose.Pdf's Image object.

create-pdf-report-multiple-tables.title: Generate PDF Report with Multiple DataTables
create-pdf-report-multiple-tables.description: Shows how to create a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf, add separate pages for each DataTable, format table headers, and save the report.

create-pdf-table-dynamic-row-count.title: Create PDF Table with Dynamic Row Count
create-pdf-table-dynamic-row-count.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF containing a table whose number of rows is determined at runtime from a collection of source records using Aspose.Pdf.

conditional-formatting-table-cells.title: Conditional Formatting of PDF Table Cells
conditional-formatting-table-cells.description: Demonstrates how to create a table in a PDF, iterate through data rows, and apply background color to cells whose numeric values exceed a defined threshold.

rotate-text-in-table-cell.title: Rotate Text Inside a Table Cell
rotate-text-in-table-cell.description: Demonstrates how to rotate text within a PDF table cell using Aspose.Pdf by creating a TextFragment, setting its rotation angle, and adding it to the cell.

rotate-table-90-degrees-pdf.title: Rotate Table 90 Degrees Using Transformation Matrix
rotate-table-90-degrees-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to rotate an entire Aspose.Pdf.Table by 90° by applying a transformation matrix to the page graphics state before adding the table.

detect-merged-cells-in-pdf-tables.title: Detect Merged Cells in PDF Tables using TableAbsorber
detect-merged-cells-in-pdf-tables.description: The example loads a PDF, extracts tables with TableAbsorber, and checks each cell's RowSpan and ColumnSpan to identify merged cells, using reflection to handle missing properties.

replace-merged-table-cells.title: Replace Merged Table Cell with Separate Cells
replace-merged-table-cells.description: Demonstrates how to manipulate a tagged PDF's logical structure with Aspose.Pdf to remove a merged table cell and replace it with individual cells by creating a new TableElement programmatically.

add-footnote-references-to-table-cells.title: Add Footnote References to Table Cells in PDF
add-footnote-references-to-table-cells.description: Shows how to insert superscript footnote numbers inside table cells and add matching footnote paragraphs at the end of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-table-at-specific-position.title: Insert Table at Specific Coordinates in PDF
insert-table-at-specific-position.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a table, positioning it at absolute X/Y coordinates using MarginInfo, adding rows, and saving the document.

right-align-table-pdf.title: Align Table to Right Margin in PDF
right-align-table-pdf.description: Shows how to right‑align a table on a PDF page by setting HorizontalAlignment to Right and adjusting the left margin using Aspose.Pdf.

set-table-border-thickness.title: Set Table Border Thickness in a Tagged PDF
set-table-border-thickness.description: Demonstrates how to create a tagged table in a PDF and configure its border thickness to 2 points using Aspose.Pdf's BorderInfo class.

apply-double-border-to-pdf-table.title: Create Table with Double Border in PDF
apply-double-border-to-pdf-table.description: Loads an existing PDF, creates a tagged table, applies a double‑like border using BorderInfo, adds header and data rows, and saves the modified document.

add-multiline-text-to-table-cell.title: Add Multiline Text to Table Cell
add-multiline-text-to-table-cell.description: Shows how to create a PDF with a table and insert multiline text into a cell by adding separate TextFragment objects separated by line‑break fragments.

add-list-items-in-table-cell.title: Add List Inside Table Cell in PDF
add-list-items-in-table-cell.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's TaggedContent API to create a table, insert a list element inside a table cell, and handle version differences with a fallback to bullet paragraphs.

extract-pdf-tables-to-csv.title: Extract Tables from PDF to CSV using TableAbsorber
extract-pdf-tables-to-csv.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, use Aspose.Pdf.TableAbsorber to detect tables on each page, and write each table's rows to separate CSV files.

extract-pdf-tables-to-datatable.title: Extract PDF Tables into DataTable with TableAbsorber
extract-pdf-tables-to-datatable.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber to locate tables on each PDF page, convert them into System.Data.DataTable objects, and output their contents.

set-custom-row-height-in-pdf-table.title: Set Custom Row Height in PDF Table
set-custom-row-height-in-pdf-table.description: Demonstrates how to assign a fixed point height to specific rows in an Aspose.Pdf table using the FixedRowHeight property.

auto-fit-table-row-height.title: Auto‑Fit Table Row Height in PDF
auto-fit-table-row-height.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF with a table whose rows automatically adjust their height to fit the cell content using Aspose.Pdf.

set-fixed-row-height-for-pdf-table-rows.title: Create PDF Table with Fixed Row Height
set-fixed-row-height-for-pdf-table-rows.description: Loads an existing PDF, creates a visual table, sets a fixed height for each row, adds the table to the first page, and saves the result.

render-wide-table-landscape.title: Create Landscape PDF with Wide Table
render-wide-table-landscape.description: Demonstrates how to set a page to landscape orientation and render a wide table that spans the page width using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-page-add-table.title: Add Rotated Table to PDF Page
rotate-page-add-table.description: Shows how to rotate a PDF page and insert both an accessible (tagged) table and a visual table onto the rotated page using Aspose.Pdf.

detect-extract-tables-rotated-pages.title: Detect Tables on Rotated PDF Pages with TableAbsorber
detect-extract-tables-rotated-pages.description: The example loads a PDF, checks each page's rotation angle, and uses TableAbsorber to locate tables on rotated pages, printing the number of tables and their bounds.

remove-tables-containing-keyword.title: Remove Tables Containing Keyword from Tagged PDF
remove-tables-containing-keyword.description: Loads a tagged PDF, scans its logical structure for tables, and deletes any table that contains a specified keyword (case‑insensitive) before saving the result.

create-pdf-table-auto-fit-columns.title: Create PDF Table with Auto‑Fit Columns
create-pdf-table-auto-fit-columns.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF, add a table, enable auto‑fit to content for columns, populate header and data rows, and save the document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-shadow-effect-to-table.title: Add Shadow Effect to a Table in PDF
add-shadow-effect-to-table.description: Demonstrates how to create a table in a PDF and simulate a shadow effect using a Graph container with a filled rectangle placed behind the table.

insert-table-into-textbox-form-field.title: Insert Table into a TextBox Form Field
insert-table-into-textbox-form-field.description: Demonstrates creating a TextBoxField, building a Table, assigning the table as the field's normal appearance via a temporary page, and saving the PDF.

add-numbered-list-in-table-cell.title: Add Numbered List Inside a Table Cell (Tagged PDF)
add-numbered-list-in-table-cell.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's TaggedContent API to create a table in a PDF and insert an ordered (numbered) list within a table cell.

multiple-tables-auto-fit-pdf.title: Create Multiple Tables with Different AutoFit Settings in PDF
multiple-tables-auto-fit-pdf.description: Demonstrates generating a PDF containing three tables, each bound to a separate DataTable and using distinct AutoFit simulations (content, page width, page height) by specifying column widths.
